oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 1769998765 - 5xx spike and p50 latency up on /v1/generate for rw-models in eu-west-1. Affected route: /chat.generate. Current error rate: 9.8% over 5m. Paging oncall.
lee: I'm on it. which rollout is active? any recent canary?
ops_jess: there was a canary started 1769994300 by deploy-bot: m-7b -> m-7b-quant-int8 (canary 10% traffic) in eu-west-1
deploy-bot: deploy 1769994300 completed. canary policy: 10% traffic, sticky_sessions=true, fallback_policy=region+variant
lee: logs look like increased decoding time + OOM traces from model loader: "KV cache alloc failed" across multiple canary hosts. Also a bunch of instant 502s from gpu-farm-12.
sre_tony: canary hosts showing model variant mismatch on a node: config shows expected `m-7b-q8` but runtime pulled `m-7b-fp16` on one machine. that could explain memory/latency mismatch.
maya: wait how would that happen? the artifact repo only has q8. Could be a packaging tag mixup between the image and model manifest.
ops_jess: grabbing fetch logs from artifact-store: `manifest.json` for canary contains `variant: q8_0` but the node reported `variant: fp16` while kernel was compiled for q8. unpack failure leads to degraded perf.
lee: impact: ~10% of requests hitting canary cluster see p95 4.8s and 502s. customer_success_ana: CSMs report a couple of enterprise customers saw degraded chat for a few minutes and one filed a support ticket.
product_sam: this aligns with a rollout policy we changed last week to sticky_sessions=true for canary to get consistent evaluation. sticky made many active sessions stick to the bad canary.
sre_tony: sticky_sessions is the issue. because of sticky routing, retries went back to canary rather than fallback. fallback_policy allowed region fallback but sticky prevented immediate distribution. we ended up with increased pressure on fallback pool.
ops_jess: observed an emergent fallback loop: canary marked unhealthy -> traffic routed to fallback variant in the same region -> fallback overloaded -> fallback triggers its own fallback to cross-region -> sticky flags cause controllers to bounce sessions around. net effect: oscillation and elevated latency cluster-wide.
lee: I'm going to pause the canary rollout and flip sticky to false for the route. executing:
```
# pause canary
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $RLW_TOKEN" https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/rollouts/1769994300/pause
# update routing policy
curl -X PATCH -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"sticky_sessions": false, "fallback_policy":{"kind":"region_prefer","max_retries":2}}' https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/routes/chat.generate/policy
```
deploy-bot: rollout 1769994300 status -> paused (ack). routing policy patch queued, applying to 3 services.
ops_jess: I also drained the canary hosts and initiated a rollback to previous stable model variant on the canary pool: `rollback 1769994300 -> 1769900001`
```
# rollback command
redwoodctl deploy rollback --id 1769994300 --to 1769900001 --scope canary
```
maya: handing this to night oncall (maya) in 10 minutes, lee please provide full timeline in the incident ticket. I'll stay on until it's stable.
lee: copying timeline here: 1769994300 canary started, 1769998765 alert fired, 1769998780 sticky traffic observed, 1769998802 patch applied, 1769998810 rollback initiated, 1769998820 rollback complete and canary drained.
customer_success_ana: CSMs notified affected customers at 1769998830 with temporary mitigation note and ETA for full root cause.
sre_tony: short term mitigation summary: paused canary, disabled sticky sessions on affected route, rolled back canary model variant, increased fallback pool capacity by +2 nodes. This stopped the oscillation. will open a follow-up to prevent mismatch between model manifest and runtime image.
product_sam: action items: (1) disable sticky by default for canaries unless perf-sensitive test requires it, (2) add manifest-image checksum check on deploy pipeline, (3) add canary health gating for KV cache alloc before proceed.
maya: I'm taking over monitoring. setting watch for 2h. assigning postmortem to lee + ops_jess + deploy infra. severity: P2 (customer-facing but quick mitigation).
lee: will file incident ticket with timeline, customer impact (error rate ~10% for ~7m for 3% of traffic, 2 enterprise customers flagged), and root cause hypothesis: variant packaging mismatch + sticky sessions exacerbated fallback loop.
oncall-bot: Incident 1769998765 updated: status -> mitigated. next: postmortem scheduled 2026-03-17 14:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
customer_success_ana: added support ticket links to incident. I'll follow up with customers once postmortem is ready. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all. keep replies to thread for the ticket notes. I'll @-mention SRE rotation for the postmortem.
